manifest.purpose: Correct word-level Verilog module barrel_shifter_top(data_in[7:0], amount[2:0], direction, mode[1:0], data_out[7:0]), purely combinational, matching public_spec.interface exactly. Implements: mode=00 logical shift (dir0=left zero-fill low, dir1=right zero-fill high); mode=01 dir1=arithmetic right shift sign-extending with data_in[7], dir0=identical to mode=00 left shift (zero-fill, NOT sign-extended, satisfies SR2); mode=10 rotate left (dir0) or rotate right (dir1) by amount mod 8 with wraparound; mode=11 must bit-exactly reproduce net_shifter_flat.v's don't-care resolution, which per the netlist's row1 mux (u_row1: a=rotate_res, b=logical_res, s=mode[0]) resolves mode=11 (mode[1]=1,mode[0]=1) to logical_res, i.e. mode=11 behaves identically to mode=00's logical shift (same direction-dependent zero-fill logical shift), NOT rotate and NOT don't-care/X. Implemented via a case statement on {mode} computing all four datapaths explicitly, defaulting mode=11 to the same logical-shift expression as mode=00, using $signed or explicit sign-fill for mode 01 right shift, and explicit rotate via concatenation ({data_in << amount} | {data_in >> (8-amount)}) style with amount==0 guarded. No latches, no X assignments, no default case left unconstrained.
